source: That is why two kernels with the same FLOP count can have very different runtimes. They may generate different memory traffic, expose different amounts of independent work, use different execution units, or suffer different amounts of synchronization and divergence. The ZXNAME0000XZ’s peak capabilities describe ceilings. The workload’s mapping onto the architecture determines how much useful work approaches those ceilings.[2,3]
zh: 这就是为什么具有相同 FLOP 计数的两个内核可能具有截然不同的运行时间。它们可能会生成不同的内存流量，暴露不同数量的独立工作，使用不同的执行单元，或者遭受不同数量的同步和发散。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的峰值能力描述了天花板。工作负载到架构的映射决定了有多少有用的工作接近这些上限。[2,3]
